title: Simple, Effective, and Totally Mess-Free!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 13, 2026

title: Modern, Much more effective version of flypaper, without the Downside.
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 25, 2026
review: I purchased the Zevo flying insect trap for my garage this winter. I was very impressed with the number of small flying insects it trapped on the glue paper trap. It was very effective.  Now that spring is moving into summer I needed to purchase some refill cartridges. The call it a cartridge, but it is just an improved version of the old fashioned flypaper. The UV LED in the trap attracts the insects where they then end up on the flypaper.  Since the cartridge included with the original trap worked so well I expect the refills to perform the same way.  The downside of flypaper was that you had to see all of the dead insects sticking from the paper.  Here the dead insects are hidden inside of the trap and you only see them while you are changing out the cartridge.
